summary: Kids fairy-tale seek & find game: simple, interactive and magical
description:
A BIG HIDE-AND-SEEK GAME INSPIRED BY FAIRY TALES
Explore and search the pictures with your fingertips. Behind rocks, under tables, up in trees… Open, lift, clear away… there are hiding places everywhere! If something’s hard to find, the magnifying glass can help! Simple, motivating, and reassuring gameplay, designed for ages 3–5.

A TRUSTED BRAND, A REFERENCE GAME
With over 20 educational apps and 20 million downloads worldwide, Pango is a safe choice for families. Hide and Seek Fairytales carries on that standard: a clear, intelligent, and caring game that develops observation, attention, and logic from age 3.

RICH, STIMULATING CONTENT
Visit Little Red Riding Hood’s forest, the Three Little Pigs’ house, the Little Mermaid’s ocean, the ogre’s castle from Puss in Boots, and Jack and the Beanstalk.
• 15 fully interactive, animated scenes packed with details to explore.
• Hiding spots that change each playthrough for lasting fun.
• “Magnifying glass” hint if your child gets stuck on a tricky item.

Each play session nurtures curiosity, builds focus, and encourages problem-solving. Designed for preschool and kindergarten, the game offers a positive learning environment—no stress, no timer, no competition.

TRY FOR FREE, THEN UNLOCK ALL CONTENT
Free download with a first set of content included.
Unlock the remaining scenes via in-app purchases — individually or as a full pack — as you prefer.
All purchases are protected by parental controls. And as always with Pango: no ads.

WHY PARENTS LOVE PANGO HIDE AND SEEK FAIRYTALES
✔ Instantly accessible, designed for little hands.
✔ Perfect for trips, quiet moments, or short sessions.
✔ 100% ad-free with no hidden purchases, with built-in parental controls.
✔ Gentle progression, gradual difficulty, a warm, humorous world.

COPPA- and GDPR-compliant for safe, independent use.

PANGO’S VALUES
For over 15 years, we’ve been creating games that respect children’s pace, spark their curiosity, and develop their logic… without stress, without ads, without pressure. Because a good game is first and foremost the one that helps kids grow!

Need help? A question? Write to us at pango@studio-pango.com
or check our FAQ.
